title: Dice Seeded Rolls
description: Deterministically seeds every die roll from a day seed and a global per-face roll counter.

dice-seeded-rolls.enabled.name: Enabled
dice-seeded-rolls.enabled.hint: Deterministically seed dice rolls from the day seed. When disabled, native randomness is used and the roll counter does not advance.

dice-seeded-rolls.daySeed.name: Day Seed
dice-seeded-rolls.daySeed.hint: Seed value used to derive every die result. Choose this to replay a day identically; the roll counter is reset separately with /roll-reset.

dice-seeded-rolls.rollIndex.name: Roll Index
dice-seeded-rolls.rollIndex.hint: Global per-die-roll counter for the current day.
